Name: WS78's Happy Wedding Pack for FS
Author: SpeedInternational
Description:
[size=2]Used best with my Flower Dance pack for FS. Masculine suits from the flower dance pack will be added as an optional file for those who don't want everything in the original pack.[/size]
I'm hoping to add more culturally significant wedding outfits, so if anyone can make suggestions of the names of both bride and groom clothing I would love to try and add it to my pack.


[size=4]This pack includes:[/size]
- 8 accessories, with 1 extra to be used with the veil
- 7 hats
- 13 pants/skirts
- 26 shirts
- 2 pairs of shoes (one for masc foot and one for fem)
- 3 pairs of sleeves

One of the accessories is coloured dots to be put on the long veil. It needs to be placed before the veil (so if the veil is on accessory slot 2, the dots need to be on slot 1). Using the layer arrows in the Fashion Sense UI, there are three different colours of dots you can change. In the image above, I've made them blue, green and purple, but you can colour them however you want.

The colourable Saree veil isn't transparent like the red, this is on purpose because I couldn't make the transparent pixels change colour with the colour mask, so in the end I made it opaque.

For a larger variety of sleeves, I suggest [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15431]SH's Gloves and Sleeves Pack[/url] by SmolHooman

[size=4]Known Issues
[/size]When holding things that appear on the characters head and standing still, Sleeves and arms will be down by your side, rather than holding the item up. This is to do with the wrong frame being specified for that part of the idle animation. Unfortunately, I'm not too knowledgeable in how the frames on sleeves work to be able to rectify this.

[size=4]New Organisation System:[/size][size=2]
[/size]Version 1.1.0 has a new naming convention for each item following a pattern of letters and numbers.
To give an example: 
﻿ABC-1c

- First letter signifies pack. 
[spoiler] [size=4]Packs and their corresponding Letters
[/size]
﻿Flower Dance
﻿ ﻿A

﻿Summer Fun
﻿ ﻿B

﻿Happy Wedding
﻿ ﻿C
[/spoiler]
- Second letter shows sets and what item of each type are made to go together. So if multiple items have B as the second letter, they're made to be used together. Feel free to mix and match!
- Third letter is meant to show gendered type. [A - Fem] [B - Masc] [C - Any/None]. But this doesn't mean you can't use them on anyone!
- Number after the dash is the variation of design in that set. So some items go in a set, but have slight differences in their designs.
- The letter c after the number lets you know the design is colourable, or some element of the clothing is colourable


If anyone has any suggestions on what they might like to see added in this pack, feel free to make suggestions. I can't promise it will happen, but I'd love to give it a go!
This is my first time making something like this, so if there are any issues, feel free to post so I can see about making fixes. I couldn't find anything wrong when I was testing, but it's easy to miss things.

This content pack won't work without PeacefulEnd's [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense
